I  ·  About Us

An enterprise built on
trust, science & tradition.

SCIBEX Biosciences Pvt. Ltd. is India's emerging bioscience house, incorporated in 2024 with a dual-division thesis — modern pharmaceuticals and Ayurvedic heritage — now expanding with a third innovation arm: AI-powered preventive care launching from New Jersey.

"

We are not just building a company.
We are building a healthcare house — at the rare moment when India's regulatory infrastructure, distribution architecture, and global hunger for natural wellness all converge.

— Harsh Shah, Founder & CEO
I Division

SCIBEX Pharma

Modern Pharmaceuticals

High-quality, affordable generic medicines distributed through India's doctor-prescription pharmacy network. Asset-light manufacturing via WHO-GMP certified partners.

  • Antibiotics, analgesics, anti-ulcerants
  • Jeetoclav-625 · Esencort-6 hero brands
  • 52–58% gross margin · 72% reorder rate
  • FDA ANDA pathway · Year 2–3
II Division

Truvedika

Heritage Ayurveda

Authentic classical Ayurvedic medicine reformulated for modern consumers. Rooted in Charaka Samhita and Sushruta. Addressing India's ₹70,000 Cr Ayurvedic market.

  • TRUPRA — Daily wellness flagship
  • HIPRA — Therapeutic flagship
  • AYUSH-licensed · 60–65% margin
  • USPTO registration · USA expansion
III Division

SCIBEX AI

AI Preventive Health Platform

The innovation engine — wearable BioSensor + AI care manager + integrated product delivery. Launching in NJ/NY 2026 for the Indian-American diaspora, scaling globally.

  • 14-organ continuous BioSensor
  • 30-day predictive disease forecast
  • AI Care Manager · 75+ languages
  • HIPAA · DPDP · GDPR compliant

IV  ·  AI Innovation

SCIBEX AI.
Health, decoded.

The SCIBEX AI app combines a wearable BioSensor with an AI care manager — monitoring 14 organ systems in real time, predicting disease 30 days before symptoms appear, and connecting you to the right doctor and the right medicine. Our entry to the global market is through AI — bringing the platform first to NJ/NY in 2026.

i.

Quantum BioSensor

Continuous wearable monitoring of 14 organ systems — heart, lungs, kidneys, brain, liver and more. 1,200+ biomarkers tracked in real time.

ii.

AI Care Manager · 75+ Languages

24/7 personalized health intelligence interpreting your BioSensor data and recommending lifestyle, products, and doctor visits — in your native language.

iii.

30-Day Disease Forecast

Diabetes spikes, cardiac events, sleep disorders, stress burnout — predicted before symptoms appear, with actionable prevention plans.

iv.

Doctor Network · NJ/NY

Primary Care + Urgent Care matching across NJ/NY counties — Hudson, Bergen, Middlesex, Manhattan, Queens. Insurance integration with Aetna, BCBS, Cigna.

V  ·  Vision & Goals

Where we're
headed.

"Building India's first integrated bioscience house — combining modern pharma, Ayurvedic heritage, and AI innovation into one global preventive healthcare platform."

"
Our Vision

To make preventive healthcare accessible, intelligent, and rooted in tradition — for every human, everywhere.

A world where chronic disease is predicted before it appears. Where 5,000-year-old Ayurvedic wisdom is delivered with modern AI precision. Where the Indian healthcare brand becomes the global gold standard for preventive medicine.

"
Our Mission

Build a category-defining global bioscience house from India.

We unite three engines — modern pharmaceuticals, Ayurvedic heritage, and AI-powered preventive care — into one ecosystem. Doctor trust drives prescription. Truvedika delivers margin. AI delivers leverage. Export delivers scale.

Why SCIBEX?

I. Reason

Founder-Led & Capital Efficient

Asset-light model. Strong unit economics. Operating revenue funds overheads today. Founder-CEO with operator track record.

II. Reason

Regulatory Ready

All key licenses secured — Drug License, GST, MSME, FSSAI, AYUSH, ISO 9001:2015, WHO-GMP aligned. Capital deploys directly into growth.

III. Reason

Differentiated Positioning

One of the few early-stage Indian brands combining Rx generics + Ayurveda + AI BioSensor + 104-SKU range under one corporate roof.

IV. Reason

Massive Addressable Market

India pharma ₹2.4L Cr + Ayurveda ₹70K Cr + global Ayurveda $23B by 2030. Combined ₹3 lakh crore+ domestic. Export adds 5× global TAM.

V. Reason

Multi-Geography Footprint

Gujarat, Mumbai, New Jersey — built for Indian scale and global reach from day one. 5M+ Indian-American TAM in NJ/NY.

VI. Reason

AI Innovation Layer

SCIBEX AI BioSensor platform unlocks predictive medicine at global scale. Convergence of biosciences × AI × wearable tech × global business.
